call_points.text: 500 sales people added in six months; full productivity expected six to twelve months out.
Affordability revenue grew close to 20% YoY; management declined to share volume numbers.
Analyst pressed on declining take rates; management said headline take rates are mix-driven, IAP take rate held at 1.3%.
Asked for MDR share of revenue, management said it was not shared in detail and did not have it at hand.
Adjusted EBITDA for FY26 reached ₹559 Cr with a 500 bps margin expansion.
Flowthrough to adjusted EBITDA runs at ₹50-57 per ₹100 of contribution margin, and ₹45-55 to PBT.
Employee cost fell to ~31% of revenue from ~37% YoY; ESOP cost is expected to stay broadly stable.
OMC contracts with BPCL, HPCL and IOCL are largely multi-year; IOCL XtraPower is a four-year mandate.
OMC rollout is activation-led with no meaningful fresh capex; fuel-retail POS footprint to reach ~130k terminals by end-FY27.
International revenue grew 44% over three years and is now ~15% of total revenue, up from 9%.
Malaysia direct acquiring business is expected to grow revenue by 50%.
Q4 growth moderated after Diwali; Middle East geopolitics cut airline volumes and pushed UAE bank rollouts to next quarter.
Depreciation leverage may moderate on higher deployments and a near-term rise in hardware costs amid the global chip shortage.
Six bank pilots are on for AI-based underwriting products, with two signed large contracts at event-based pricing.

operating_notes.text: Shopflo reported turnover of ₹0.63 Cr in FY23, ₹9.16 Cr in FY24, and ₹14.74 Cr in FY25.
Pine Labs entered the Philippines market through a partnership with GCash for Business as its first payments partner.
Pine Labs expects to utilise the remaining ₹1,282.72 Cr of IPO proceeds by the end of FY28.
Platform GTV was ₹1,715 thousand crore in FY26 versus ₹1,143 thousand crore in FY25.
Digital checkout points reached 20.3 lakh at end-FY26, up 14% YoY, with 30% of DCPs generating flow and affordability volumes.
International revenue was ~15% of total revenue in FY26, up from 9% three years ago, growing 44% over three years.
89% of all new code written within Pine Labs over the last two quarters has been completely AI generated.
About 70% of offline POS transactions are on UPI, with average UPI ticket size above ₹1,400.
OMC terminal rollout: 90,000-1 lakh of a planned 125,000-130,000 deployed, with 60-70% of contract value captured and the rest expected in Q2-Q3 FY27.
Credit processing (issuing and acquiring) is about ₹100 Cr of annual revenue across roughly 20 countries; IAP take rate is 1.3%.

timeline.summary: Pine Labs approved the acquisition of 100% stake in Shopflo Technologies for up to ₹88 Cr to build a unified commerce platform.
On 12 May 2026, Pine Labs announced its entry into the Philippines market via a partnership with GCash for Business to provide merchant payment and POS infrastructure.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹700.51 Cr, net profit ₹59.36 Cr.

On 25 May 2026, Pine Labs' Q4/FY26 shareholder letter reported FY26 revenue of ₹2,711 Cr (up 19%), adjusted EBITDA of ₹559 Cr and PAT of ₹113 Cr, and guided 21-23.5% revenue growth over the next few years.
Neerav Mehta uploaded the audio/video recording of Pine Labs’ May 26, 2026, Analysts/Investors conference call on the company’s website.
On June 1, 2026, Pine Labs filed the transcript of its Q4 and Full Year FY2026 earnings call held on May 26, 2026.
Pine Labs Limited’s management will host Investor and Analyst Day 2026 on June 16, 2026, from 11 AM to 4 PM at Grand Hyatt, Mumbai.
On 29 July 2026 Pine Labs' Q1FY27 call reported 20% revenue growth; adjusted EBITDA of ₹126 Cr against ~₹140 Cr management expected
Pine Labs invested ₹25.00 Cr in a rights issue of its wholly owned subsidiary SFNPL on October 21, 2026.

watchlist.response: Management said it is a deliberate market-entry strategy (distribution first, then processing) plus low-margin upfront device sales, and guided full-year contribution margin back to 73-74%.
